hrPayroll.codeRule: Letters, digits, dashes and underscores, 32 at most.

calculators.custom: A calculator this server adds. Its settings are written as JSON.

fixed.name: Fixed monthly amount
fixed.hint: The amount on the employee's pay, prorated by the days each line ran in the month.

per_attendance_day.name: Per day present
per_attendance_day.hint: The amount on the employee's pay for each day attendance recorded as present.

percent_of.name: Percent of other lines
percent_of.hint: A percent of earlier lines on the slip. An amount on the employee's pay overrides the percent.

rate_table.name: Legal rate table
rate_table.hint: A rate table on a base — insurance or tax. A percent table up to its ceiling; a brackets table progressively.

overtime.name: Overtime
overtime.hint: Approved overtime hours × the hourly rate × the multiplier.

unpaid_days.name: Unpaid days
unpaid_days.hint: A deduction for approved unpaid leave and days resolved as absent, at the daily rate.

loan_installment.name: Loan installments
loan_installment.hint: The installments of active loans due in the month.

benefit_allowance.name: Benefit allowance
benefit_allowance.hint: Pays the cash allowances of benefits linked to this component.

config.prorateHint: Off pays the latest amount in full.
config.multiplierTable: Or the multiplier from a percent table
config.rawObject: Write the settings as one JSON object.

components.description: What a payslip is made of: each line's kind, how it is worked out, and its order — earlier lines feed later ones, so basic comes before a percent of it and the gross before a tax on it.
components.name: Name
components.appliesToAllHint: A component on every payslip is worked out for each employee; any other only for employees whose pay has it.
components.empty: No pay components yet. Add basic pay first.
components.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? A component that pay or payslips use cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

rateTables.description: The legal rates payroll reads — social insurance, income tax — in dated versions, so each month is worked out with the rate of its own time. A run uses the version in force on the month's last day.

kindHint.percent: One rate on the base, up to a ceiling if one is set.
kindHint.brackets: Each band of the base at its own rate.

rateTables.kindFixed: The kind is fixed once the table exists.
rateTables.noVersions: No versions yet. Add one for the rate in force.
rateTables.deleteConfirm: Delete the table {code}? A table with versions stays, as part of the payroll history.
rateTables.versionHint: A new version of {code}. Versions never overlap: end the one in force first.
rateTables.closeHint: The version stops applying after this date.
rateTables.bracketsHint: Bands rise; the last has no upper limit.
rateTables.currencyHint: Ceilings and bands are in this currency; none means the run's.

problems.openMiddle: Only the last band may have no upper limit.
problems.order: Each band's limit must be above the one before.

pay.title: Pay
pay.subtitle: The employee's pay lines over time
pay.changeHint: The pay as it will be from the date chosen: every line running then ends the day before. The change also shows on the career tab.
pay.endsPay: No lines: the pay ends on this date.
pay.percentHint: For a percent component, the amount is the employee's own percent.

endOfService.title: End of service
endOfService.subtitle: What the employee would be owed on the date
endOfService.description: What every employee in service on the date would be owed at the end of their service, and the total by currency.
endOfService.empty: No employees in service on this date.

runs.description: Every payroll run, newest month first. Open a run to calculate, review, approve and pay it.

kindHint.regular: The month's payroll, one a month, calculated once the month's attendance is locked.
kindHint.off_cycle: A correction or a one-off — a bonus, a final settlement — for the employees named, made of adjustments.

runs.parallelHint: Run beside the payroll in use; someone confirms the two match before it can be approved.

run.title: Payroll — {period}
run.notFound: This payroll run does not exist.

confirm.reconcile: Confirm this parallel payroll matches the payroll it runs beside? Only then can it be approved.
confirm.approve: Approve this payroll? Its payslips are issued to the employees, loan installments are deducted, and it can no longer change — a correction is an off-cycle run.
confirm.post: Mark this payroll as posted to accounting? It is marked once.
confirm.cancel: Delete this payroll run and its payslips? It has not been approved, so nothing has been issued.

run.reconcileFirst: This parallel payroll must be confirmed against the current one before it can be approved.
run.needsRecalculation: An adjustment changed this payroll after it was calculated. Calculate it again before review.
run.payHint: Record that the net pay ({net}) has been paid out.

variance.against: Each payslip against the same employee's in the last approved monthly payroll.
variance.noPrevious: No earlier approved monthly payroll to compare with.

adjustments.subtitle: One-off lines on a slip, each with its reason
adjustments.hint: A one-off line on one employee's slip — a bonus, a correction. A calculated run goes back to open and needs calculating again.
adjustments.removeConfirm: Remove this adjustment? The run goes back to open and needs calculating again.

journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: The approved run as accounting lines, each expense split by cost center

payslip.title: Payslip
payslip.notFound: This payslip does not exist or has not been issued.
payslip.footer: This payslip was generated by ADD's HR system from the approved payroll.

warnings.negativeNet: The deductions are larger than the pay: the net is below zero.
warnings.noRate: No version of the rate table {code} was in force.

loans.description: Every loan, newest first. A loan is approved in the approval flow, then repaid by payroll month by month.
loans.hint: It goes for approval. One open loan at a time, up to a multiple of monthly pay; the first installment is taken from the month chosen.
loans.scheduleOnApproval: The repayment schedule is laid out once the loan is approved.
loans.settleHint: What is still due ({amount}) is settled outside payroll — paid back in cash, or in a final settlement.
loans.cancelConfirm: Cancel this loan request? Its approval request is withdrawn.

mine.description: Your payslips, once each payroll is approved, and your loans.
mine.oneOpenLoan: You can ask for another loan once this one is repaid.
